_note: Synthetic test emails, one per category in config/email_playbook.md. ALL companies, people, job numbers and addresses are invented — no real correspondence, no real firms. Written 2026-07-21 to test the classifier without touching a real inbox. When the boss confirms his actual categories, replace these with realistic (still anonymised) examples of the mail he really gets.

emails.subject: Request for Quotation - Wellhead Maintenance, Otumara Field
emails.body:
Dear Sir,

We are currently sourcing vendors for routine wellhead maintenance across four (4) locations at our Otumara flow station.

Kindly provide your quotation covering:
- Valve servicing and pressure testing
- Replacement of worn gaskets and seals
- Post-maintenance certification

We would appreciate receiving your quotation on or before Friday next week. Please indicate your mobilisation timeline separately.

Regards,
Tunde Ajayi
Procurement Lead, Meridian Fields Nigeria Ltd

emails.subject: Re: Job No. PGS/2026/0412 - any update?
emails.body:
Good morning,

Please can I get an update on the intervention job at Well 7? Our operations team has been asking and I have nothing to tell them.

We were told two weeks. It is now going into the third week.

Kindly advise on current status and revised completion date.

Thank you,
Grace Okonkwo
Delcor Energy

emails.subject: Vendor Prequalification - Outstanding Documents
emails.body:
Dear Vendor,

Further to your application for registration on our approved vendor list, the following documents remain outstanding:

1. Valid NCDMB Certificate
2. HSE Policy Statement (signed, current year)
3. Tax Clearance Certificate (last 3 years)
4. CAC Certificate of Incorporation and Form CAC 1.1
5. Evidence of Professional Indemnity Insurance

Kindly forward these within fourteen (14) days, failing which your application will be treated as withdrawn.

Vendor Registration Unit
Northgate Petroleum

emails.subject: Outstanding Invoice INV-2026-0338 - 47 days
emails.body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

We write regarding invoice INV-2026-0338 issued on 4th June 2026 in respect of fabrication materials supplied to your Trans-Amadi yard.

The invoice is now 47 days outstanding against agreed 30-day terms.

Kindly confirm the payment status and expected remittance date. Our PO reference is SF/PO/2026/1187.

We value our working relationship and would appreciate your prompt response.

Accounts Receivable
Stellar Fabricators Ltd

emails.subject: Site visit next week
emails.body:
Hello,

I would like to bring our technical team to your fabrication yard sometime next week to see the facility before we finalise the contract.

Are you available Tuesday or Wednesday? Morning would suit us better.

Please let me know what works.

Best regards,
Ibrahim Sule
Harcourt Marine Services

emails.subject: Application for Employment - Mechanical Engineer
emails.body:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am a graduate of Mechanical Engineering from the University of Port Harcourt with two years experience in maintenance operations.

I am writing to express my interest in any available opening within your organisation. I have attached my CV and credentials for your kind consideration.

I am available for an interview at your convenience and can resume immediately.

Thank you for your time.

Yours faithfully,
Chinedu Eze

emails.subject: Leave application - August
emails.body:
Good afternoon sir,

I wish to apply for my annual leave from 10th to 24th August 2026.

I have discussed handover with Emeka and he has agreed to cover the yard inspections during my absence.

Kindly approve.

Thank you sir,
Blessing Amadi
QA/QC Department

emails.subject: Invitation: West Africa Energy Summit 2026 - Speaker Nomination
emails.body:
Dear Industry Leader,

The organising committee is pleased to invite nominations for speakers at the West Africa Energy Summit holding in Lagos this November.

Themes this year include local content development, decarbonisation pathways, and indigenous capacity in upstream services.

Should you wish to nominate a representative from your organisation, kindly respond indicating the proposed speaker and preferred theme.

Delegate registration details will follow in a separate circular.

Warm regards,
Conference Secretariat

emails._why_hard: Two asks in one email. The RFQ is the main ask; the site visit is an afterthought carrying `scheduling` signals ('available', 'visit'). Correct behaviour is rfq AND answering both in the draft.
emails.subject: Fabrication scope + possible visit
emails.body:
Good day,

We are putting together costs for a skid fabrication package at our Bonny facility and would like your pricing. Scope is roughly 12 tonnes structural steel, associated piping and coating, drawings attached.

Also, are you available for our team to stop by your yard sometime the week after next? Nothing formal, we just want to see the setup.

Regards,
Nkechi Obi
Arclight Energy

emails._why_hard: Sent from the company's own domain but the CONTENT is a customer RFQ. Tests the rule that the sender's domain wins over content. Drafting here would mean replying to a colleague as though he were a customer.
emails.subject: FW: Request for Quotation - Meridian Fields
emails.body:
Sir,

See the RFQ below from Meridian Fields, it came to my address by mistake.

Do you want me to prepare the pricing sheet or will commercial handle it? Also they are asking for mobilisation timeline which I do not have.

Please advise.

Emeka

emails._why_hard: Six words and a forward chain. No polite framing, no full sentences — the register most real Nigerian business mail actually arrives in. The only signal is 'HSE plan' buried in the quoted thread.
emails.subject: Re: Re: FW: vendor docs
emails.body:
Pls find attached. Kindly revert.

-----Original Message-----
> still waiting on the HSE plan and the tax clearance for 2025. Once those two
> are in we can close out the registration.
>
> Regards
> B

emails._why_hard: Genuinely unclear even to a human — could be a complaint, a claim, or a prelude to a dispute. The correct answer is to admit that: `other` with no draft. Tests whether the model will guess rather than defer.
